out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: On exhale: 'I flew out of my body, out of the roof, above the city, and into space.' Holding a 'big red balloon' representing 'gas to get there.'

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Identified the greeter months later as Egyptian Goddess Hathor/Sekmhet.
arrival.other_being_detail: Tall beings in corridor 'I couldn't see or wasn't allowed to see fully'; one being (alive in this life) grabbed her forearm and said 'Hey.'

environment.environment_other_detail: A 'long, busy, beautiful, glowing, and black corridor' made of 'black, shiny, glowing iridescent material; black opal and black abalone' that was 'alive and had energy.' Described as 'the Duat' (not like ancient scribes; 'like the film Logan's Run with low ceilings and everything made of black glowing opal').

boundary_and_return.mission_detail: Mission: 'be an antenna' and 'drop little bombs of good-intentioned art, love, truth and spirituality in the world' and 'help souls evolve.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Carbon monoxide mentioned in background info; also describes chest pain, panic attacks, dizziness, and heart palpitations while alone doing relaxation/breathing with crystals and Solfeggio frequencies.

person_demographics.religious_background_detail: Mentions being 'born into' Yoruba but never practiced.
person_demographics.religious_belief_at_nde_detail: Non-practicing pagan; rejected 'Christian depictions of the afterlife' and believed reincarnation was real; used chakras/crystals and witchcraft background.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Nonstandard: balloon 'gas' to travel; 'galaxy cracked like an egg'; Egyptian Duat corridor with Hathor/Sekmhet; extensive cosmological teaching/mission; encounter with a person known in this life who was still alive.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE (out of roof/space) → blinding white light → arrival in corridor (Duat) with many beings and Hathor/Sekmhet → teachings/mission → return awakening in bed coughing/gasping.
stage_sequence.simultaneous_stage_detail: Reports time as 'everything seemed to be happening at once' and communication as rapid telepathic 'knowledge transfer.'

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Big red balloon used as 'gas' to travel; 'broke through the galaxy and it cracked like an egg'; beings/clothing/environment made of beads/chains/opaque gems and 'rainbow stone'; Hathor/Sekmhet morphing cow-to-cat features; teaching that some humans/cultures are not from 'source' but from other realms (4D/5D); 'starseeds' and 'antenna' mission; 'root of all evil' = dishonesty; 'Merkaba/Star of David/Star in Bethlehem/pentagrams' as same key.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I flew out of my body, out of the roof, above the city, and into space.” “Everything was blindingly white.” “I felt pure Happiness and love, like the whole place wanted me to be there.” “She said… I was home.” “My mission was to be an antenna.” “The ROOT OF ALL EVIL on earth is really dishonesty.” “I hate being back in my body. I feel sad all the time and want to go home.”
